newsitem.title: USA: Premisys sees lower results, share loss.
newsitem.headline: Premisys sees lower results, share loss.

text.p: Premisys Communications Inc said Friday it expects revenues and results for the quarter ending March 31, 1997 to be "significantly less" than for the same period last year.

The company said in a release that it sees revenues for the quarter as between $10 and $12 million, and it expects a share loss -- including a previously announced charge of $0.09 per share -- of $0.10 to $0.14.
The company said it believes the decline in revenues is due to "deferral or loss of several equipment deployments by Premisys' domestic and international distribution partners."
The company will report its financial results for the quarter ending March 31, 1997 on April 21.
Premisys reported revenues of $26.3 million for the quarter ended December 31, 1996 and earnings per share of $0.23.
Shares of Premisys fell more than 32 percent, shedding 3-5/8 to 7-5/8 and touching a new low of 7.
